searchText: Throwing in some dates/times. Thumbs up to ones that for work for you. Tuesday Wednesday And which time zone are you? America’s European The traditional time is around 16:00 UTC, but that is for both EU and US participation. Hey hey, Australia here ;P. Brisbane, AEST 16:00 UTC is midnight here, so I'd vote for something else ... and relatedly, it's hard to make sense of the day without a timezone, but I'd tentatively vote "Tuesday", which might mean my Wednesday I spent some more time writing up details of what I think a DHT based network would look like, based on my previous experiments a few months back. https://notes.ethereum.org/EYRD1-NZQ5aVRCsM4fg92Q Astute readers will note there is a big gaping hole around accounts and storage that needs to be figured out. I'm hoping this can serve as either a starting point for specifying something DHT based if there is agreement on that direction, or can help inform alternate proposals for how this network is built.

excerpts.author: pipermerriam
excerpts.content:
I spent some more time writing up details of what I think a DHT based network would look like, based on my previous experiments a few months back.

https://notes.ethereum.org/EYRD1-NZQ5aVRCsM4fg92Q

Astute readers will note there is a big gaping hole around accounts and storage that needs to be figured out.  I'm hoping this can serve as either a starting point for specifying something DHT based if there is agreement on that direction, or can help inform alternate proposals for how this network is built.
